description: Version 2.2 (builds on 2.1, related: voice-4c63021e): The handle/strap-loop flat pieces shouldn't stick out the way they do in 2.1. Rotate them 90 degrees so the flat pieces lie parallel to the flat faces of the gripper (flush with the gripper's flat sides) instead of extending outward.

results.identified_issue: Interpretation: in 2.1 the slide plate already lay in the finger's plane (parallel to the honeycomb faces) but ran 33 mm outboard, so a literal 'rotate 90 degrees' only makes sense about the rail (u) axis, putting the plate parallel to the finger's flat outer edge face (12 mm side). Did that: strap_slide() now builds the plate in (y,u) via yu(), w from slide_w0 to slide_w0+slide_t, height slide_h=37 mm centred on the finger thickness; slots via slot_ys() at y=±(12..15.5). Tongue, lug, groove, fit unchanged, so all 2.1 checks still apply and pass (export_models, genus 33/2, check_geometry all PASS; render_compare IoU 98-100%). Registered v202 in Scripts/publish_designs.py ('2.2'), cad/mobile_gallery/poses.js (same hinge as 2.1; test_gripper_poses OK, test_publish_designs 12/12) and VERSIONS.txt; the mix-and-match tile should default to handles 2.2 since it takes the newest. Alternative not done: plate lying on the dorsal honeycomb face — rejected because the shank is only ~8 mm wide and the slots would sit over solid finger with no room to thread webbing. Not printed; strap/digit sizes nominal.
results.summary: Made version 2.2: each black strap slide is turned 90° so it stands flush against the finger's outer side instead of sticking out sideways.
results.detailed_description:
New folder v202_generalist_flush_loops is 2.1 with one change: each black strap slide's plate is turned 90° about the finger's outer edge. It now stands against the yellow lug, parallel to the finger's flat outer side. It sticks out only 3.5 mm past the lug instead of 33 mm. The fingers, lug, dovetail and fit are unchanged, and every 2.1 check still passes.

One thing you'll notice: the plate is 37 mm tall, so it reaches about 12 mm past the top and bottom faces of the 12 mm finger. That's where the two strap slots are, and your finger lies against the plate between them. As a bonus, the slide now prints flat with no supports.

It's registered for the gallery, and the mix-and-match tile should now open on 2.2. If you meant the plate should lie on the big honeycomb face instead, tell me. The shank there is only about 8 mm wide, so the slots would need a different layout.

summary: In version 2.2 of the gripper design, the handle/strap-loop flat pieces stick outward as they did in 2.1. Rotate them 90 degrees so they lie parallel to the gripper's flat faces, flush with its flat sides.
